name: How much does it cost to convert a garage into a guest house in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to convert a garage into a guest house in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost for a garage-to-guest-house conversion in the Las Vegas area can vary significantly, typically ranging from $50,000 to $150,000 or more. Factors influencing the price include the size of the garage, the extent of structural modifications, the quality of finishes, the complexity of plumbing and electrical work, and any necessary permits or impact fees. A basic conversion with standard finishes will be less expensive than a luxury build with high-end fixtures. It's recommended to get a detailed quote tailored to your specific project and property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Conversion costs in Las Vegas typically range from $50,000 to $150,000+, depending on size, finishes, and the extent of work needed.
